description: Show which workspace the connected project belongs to (personal, or a team) and that workspace's wallet balance. Everything run or bought through this connection is charged to this wallet. In a team it also gives the team role calls act with, admin or member. Use it before paid work and when a call is refused for insufficient balance. With recent_transactions it also lists the wallet's latest transactions, the rows the Transactions page of the Wiro dashboard shows, which is how to check that a charge or a credit landed. In a team the wallet is shared, so the list holds the activity of the whole team. It also lists the workspace's spend limits and says whether this connection can change Spend Limits and Model Access rules (get_controls shows the rules).

recent_transactions.description: Also list this many of the wallet's latest transactions, newest first (1 to 50). Leave it out to read only the balance.

transactions_start.description: How many of the latest rows to skip, from nextStart in the last answer. Without recent_transactions it lists 20 rows.

name: get_account

canManage.description: Whether this connection can change the Spend Limits and Model Access rules.

spendLimits.description: The workspace's spend limits with what each has used this period. A used-up limit refuses new work with error code 93 even when the wallet has money.

heldUsd.description: Held by work that is still running, until it is charged or ends.

period.description: Monthly limits reset on the 1st, daily ones at 00:00 UTC.

scope.description: What the limit caps: the whole wallet (account), one team member, one API key (project), one way in (surface: web, api, mcp, llm-gateway, extension, agent) or one agent.

target.description: The member's uuid, the project id, the surface or the agent guid; absent for the whole wallet.

usedUp.description: True when new work this limit covers is refused (error code 93).

spendLimitsError.description: Why the spend limits could not be read, when the balance could.

amountUsd.description: The amount in USD, always positive; direction gives the sign.

direction.description: Whether the row adds to the wallet or takes from it.

expiresAt.description: For credit that can be spent only for a while: when it ends.

type.description: The row's type as the wallet page names it, such as PAYMENT, PAYMENT (COUPON), DEPOSIT or TRANSFER IN.

transactionsError.description: Why the transactions could not be read, when the balance could.

title: Get Wiro account balance and workspace
